description: Set or change the company frequency cap: at most maxEmails marketing emails per contact in any windowHours. Applies from the next email step onward to sequences with frequencyCapEnabled (set it with create_sequence or update_sequence). Campaigns count toward the cap but always send. Transactional emails never count and are never skipped.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

maxEmails.description: Most marketing emails one contact may receive in the window (1-50). 1 means a contact gets at most one marketing email per window.

windowHours.description: Rolling window in hours (1-168). For example 16 for one day of quiet, 168 for a week.

name: set_frequency_cap

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `set_frequency_cap` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
